title: The return with Zorobabel
summary: The returning people came with Zorobabel; he and Jesus the son of Josedec made ready the altar.

date.text: No absolute date stated for the return

uncertainty: The rebuilding is dated to the second year and second month after coming to the temple (1 Esdras 5:56); do not date the return itself from that statement. This return overlaps The Exile. Esdras's later return (1 Esdras 8:1-3) must be a separate event. No verified class excerpt selected yet.

title: Alexander and the Greek kingdom

date.text: No absolute date stated in the cited passage

teaching.quote: Alexander had everything united as one. These guys, they could not unite. They divided up the kingdom.

uncertainty: The passage gives a reign length, not a BCE year. No calendar conversion proposed.

title: The desolation of the altar
summary: The abomination of desolation was set upon the altar, and idol altars were built throughout the cities of Juda.

teaching.quote: so not only did they defile the temple they put Idols throughout the cities of Judah that's what the Greeks did

source.title: Who & What is the Abomination of Desolation

uncertainty: Day precision applies to the source calendar only. The sacrifice on the idol altar is the 25th, not the 15th.
